KNOW #11 📚 Gold Itna Tez Kyun?
Gold me minutes me sainkdon pips kaise?
• Gold dollar, interest rates aur darr, teeno pe react karta hai.
• US news jaise CPI ya NFP pe gold seconds me $10–20 hil sakta hai.
• Gold me $1 move pe 1 lot ka $100 banta hai.
Tip: gold me lot size forex se chhota rakho.
